nodes.description: Public mapping address => uint256 tracking token balances of accounts.
Public string token name 'COLOMBIA_WINS'.
Public string token symbol 'COLWII'.
Public uint8 number of decimals (18).
Public uint256 total token supply, minted to deployer.
Public nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 approval amounts.
Constructor that mints totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer from zero address.
Transfers value tokens from msg.sender to address to; checks balance and mutates balances.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval.
Transfers value from 'from' to 'to' using allowance[from][msg.sender]; requires balance and allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance key and operator.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic in Solidity 0.4.x.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic that can overflow.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic that can overflow.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value assignment without zero-allowance race mitigation.
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply minting assignment in constructor.
